_note: Copilot CLI model ids as the CLI reference lists them (docs.github.com, command reference, read 2026-10-09). multiplier = premium requests per CLI prompt on a LEGACY request-based annual plan: null = NOT FILLED (the harness then counts 1 per prompt and flags it; the legacy multiplier table was not read). price_per_mtok = USD per million tokens, DEFAULT-context rows of https://docs.github.com/en/copilot/reference/copilot-billing/models-and-pricing read 2026-10-09 (1 AI credit = 0.01 USD; the long-context tier and cache-write prices are not modelled, so credits are an approximation). Put your own corrected copy in a file named by FX_MODELS_FILE if your plan differs. The ids your account can actually call are found by models-discover.mjs.

defaults._note: Defaults for run-phase.mjs. They are the ids in the CLI reference table (verified 2026-10-09) and are filtered by models-discover.mjs against what YOUR account can actually call. Override with FX_CRITIC_MODELS, FX_PRACTITIONER_MODELS, FX_MODEL_ANTH / FX_MODEL_OAI / FX_MODEL_GOOG.
defaults.diversity_rule: Protocol critic rounds (FX-1, SDX-1, SDX-8/9, CMP-1, E2E-1, REM-1) need at least 3 vendors and at least 2 not Anthropic: Anthropic + OpenAI + Google through Copilot meets it. For the WP5 and Functions panels the runbooks say a Claude model adds nothing to diversity (the first panel was all Claude): they need at least 2 non-Anthropic vendors to complete all roles.
